rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS_Profile {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS based on JA3 fingerprint and URI pattern"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        date = "2026-04-11"
    strings:
        $uri1 = "/assets/js/" nocase
        $uri2 = "/static/css/" nocase
        $host_pattern = "^[a-z]{8,12}\.com$" fullword ascii
        $ja3_hash = "e86f10ba1c3b7e8e7a3c9d5f8a6b0c1d" // Simulated JA3 hash
    condition:
        all of ($uri*) and $host_pattern and $ja3_hash
}
